name: Glamoured Studded Leather
description: Studded leather that looks like whatever its wearer last wished it to.
body:
## What it does

It guards better than plain studded leather. As a bonus action you can make it look like ordinary clothes or any other armor you choose. It keeps its weight and feel, and the illusion ends when you take it off.

features.name: Glamour
features.text: As a bonus action, make it look like ordinary clothing or another kind of armor.
